proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C
  have key : ∀ X Y Z : P, dist (midpoint ℝ X Y) (midpoint ℝ X Z) = (1 / 2) * dist Y Z := by
    intro X Y Z
    rw [dist_eq_norm_vsub V, dist_eq_norm_vsub V Y Z, midpoint_vsub_midpoint_same_left, norm_smul]
    norm_num
  have h1 : dist (midpoint ℝ B C) (midpoint ℝ C A) = (1 / 2) * dist A B := by
    rw [midpoint_comm (R := ℝ) B C, key, dist_comm]
  have h2 : dist (midpoint ℝ C A) (midpoint ℝ A B) = (1 / 2) * dist B C := by
    rw [midpoint_comm (R := ℝ) C A, key, dist_comm]
  have h3 : dist (midpoint ℝ A B) (midpoint ℝ B C) = (1 / 2) * dist C A := by
    rw [midpoint_comm (R := ℝ) A B, key, dist_comm]
  refine ⟨similar_iff_exists_pos_dist_eq.mpr ⟨1 / 2, by norm_num, fun i j => ?_⟩, h1, h2, h3⟩
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp <;> grind [dist_comm]
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C : P), Similar ![midpoint ℝ B C, midpoint ℝ C A, midpoint ℝ A B] ![A, B, C] ∧ dist (midpoint ℝ B C) (midpoint ℝ C A) = 1 / 2 * dist A B ∧ dist (midpoint ℝ C A) (midpoint ℝ A B) = 1 / 2 * dist B C ∧ dist (midpoint ℝ A B) (midpoint ℝ B C) = 1 / 2 * dist C A
